title: Genome-scale CRISPR screen identifies TMEM41B as a multi-function host factor required for coronavirus replication [PigGeCKO]
model: PK-15-Cas9 porcine cells, genome-scale PigGeCKO knockout library, TGEV survival selection
contrast: TGEV challenge round 3 (and round 1) vs unselected control library (1 vs 1, no replicates)
paper_method: MAGeCK, top 0.5% enriched sgRNAs per round
paper_calls: ANPEP (TGEV receptor) and TMEM41B as headline enriched genes
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 (conservative no-replicate dispersion); TMEM41B #3 and ANPEP #3 by enrichment, median-ratio totals (capped for round 1)
named_hits: 2/2 top-ranked: TMEM41B #3, ANPEP #3 (round 1); neither reaches FDR 0.10
verdict: BARCS puts the paper's two headline genes, TMEM41B and ANPEP, at the top of the enrichment list, but one library per round and no controls leave them short of FDR 0.10; the focused library GSE169108 confirms them.
